fields:

  private Lean.EnvironmentHeader.moduleName2Idx✝ : Std.HashMap Name ModuleIdx :=
    (let m := ∅;
      do
      let __s ←
        forIn' [:self.modules.size] m fun idx _h __s =>
            let m := __s;
            let mod := self.modules[idx];
            let m := m.insert mod.module idx;
            pure (ForInStep.yield m)
      let m : Std.HashMap Name ModuleIdx := __s
      pure m).run
  Lean.EnvironmentHeader.importAllModules : Array EffectiveImport :=
    Array.filter (fun x => x.importAll) self.modules
  Lean.EnvironmentHeader.moduleData : Array ModuleData :=
    #[]
